portfolio: Owns a portfolio of 5 security and people-risk products end to end, spanning visitor management, physical access control, travel risk, and background screening.

caseStudies.title: Hardening and scaling a security-focused visitor management platform
caseStudies.context: Morgan Stanley · Product Owner, end to end
caseStudies.problem: The platform was expanding to new sites while carrying a compliance gap in how access entitlements were classified, a backlog of recurring user-access issues, and long-standing open risk items.
did: Set up an entitlement classification process that closed the compliance gap.
Worked with risk and vendor teams to resolve long-standing risk items and keep the vendor-hosted environment running without disruption.
Fixed the root causes of recurring access problems in the identity setup (SSO, role-based access, group-based provisioning), clearing the backlog.
Added sandbox test environments to speed up testing and onboarding.
Ran the rollout with no dedicated squad, while support demand rose about 10x (peaking at 19 issues in a month).

caseStudies.title: Taking a smart-lock access control platform from proof of concept to a five-branch pilot
caseStudies.context: Morgan Stanley · Product Owner · in progress
caseStudies.problem: Moving branch offices to smart-lock physical access meant a new system had to pass security architecture review, fit the firm's identity provisioning, and prove it could scale before any wider rollout.
did: Took the platform from an initial proof of concept to a structured five-branch pilot.
Designed the user-provisioning model that ties door access to the firm's identity processes.
Ran the security remediation programme with the vendor.
Validated the infrastructure needed to scale, and moved the commercial and governance approvals forward.
results: Contract and governance approvals in progress
